card.name: Quoted speech in news stories
card.fires_on: Words inside or just after a person's quoted remarks in news-style web text, such as the verb or adverb after a quote opens or a speaker is named. Also on titles like Mr before a name.

modes.label: Inside a quote
modes.description: A word within a spoken quotation, often a verb or intensifier early in the quoted sentence.
modes.example: "Jerry is<< really>> an intrepid explorer, says Kal Mull

modes.label: Reporting a speaker
modes.description: A verb or title right after a named person in reported speech.
modes.example: This afternoon Gayle Tzemach Lemmon<< talked>> with Mercy Corps’ communications director Joy Port

card.writes: Little clear effect; it weakly suppresses first-person words like my and myself.
card.plain: It lights up on words in the middle of people's quoted comments in news articles.
